method: Selected existing tests copied to /tmp/viewer-contrast-r14; only localhost:4174 replaced with 127.0.0.1:4190, assertions unchanged; Chromium, one worker. Own probes recorded separately.
grep: a note's action|existing tools default|full replacement requires|stale review stays|an all-conflict preview|external program change keeps|a refused folder

tests.title: external program change keeps buffer A, shows the conflict, saves A only
a refused folder keeps the last listing and offers no Retry; a transient failure retries
a note's action keeps its words: the legacy palette note at 150 % portrait
existing tools default to reviewed metadata refresh, not full replacement
full replacement requires selecting that mode and shows length replacement
stale review stays visible as an error and never falls back to replacement
an all-conflict preview cannot submit a metadata refresh
